searchText: Hey all, I've added some reference tests for phase0 gossip validation functions [here](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4902#issuecomment-4052059869). Please test them out if you're interested and report back 🙂 The `v1.7.0-alpha.3` release is now available: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/releases/tag/v1.7.0-alpha.3 Also, reminder that ethspec.tools is a thing 🙂 https://ethspec.tools/#specs/v1.7.0-alpha.3/ And there's a new "what changed" button at the top.
